description: This Java class contains integration tests for the Loan down payment and chargeback functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It extends a base test class and includes two test methods that cover scenarios of making down payments on loans, applying chargebacks, and verifying corresponding repayment schedules and journal entries.

classes.name: LoanDownPaymentTransactionChargebackTest
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying down payment and chargeback processes in loans.

methods.name: loanDownPaymentTransactionChargebackTest
methods.description: Tests the process of making a down payment, applying a chargeback, and verifying the impact on the loan's repayment schedule and journal entries.

methods.name: loanDownPaymentTransactionChargebackForAdvancedPaymentAllocationTest
methods.description: Tests similar down payment and chargeback scenarios but for a loan product configured with advanced payment allocation.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultiDisbursalAndRepaymentsWithEnableDownPayment
methods.description: Creates a loan product with multiple disbursal features, repayment settings, and down payment enabled, based on input parameters.

methods.name: reviewLoanTransactionRelations
methods.description: Verifies the transaction relations and outstanding balances for a given loan transaction.
